stages.journal: Grettir said it in six words and looked away: the kobolds carry marked tools. His brother's crew struck every head with the guild mark before the seal went down. Past the *Deep Market*, southeast, there's a tunnel choked with rubble — the warrens are through the gap. Thin them until the diggers start dropping what they carry.
They have them. Twenty years of kobold hands on his brother's iron, and the mark still reads. Bring Grettir three pieces he can put on a bench and know. Not one. Three — enough that it isn't luck.
